description_en: Retrieves the details of a synchronization task or a data synchronization solution
description_zh: 获取数据集成实时同步任务和同步解决方案的详情
name: GetDISyncTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object that you want to query. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: real-time synchronization task

DI_SOLUTION: data synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：

DI_REALTIME：表示数据集成实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示数据集成同步解决方案
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If you set TaskType to DI_REALTIME, set this parameter to the ID of the real-time synchronization task that you want to deploy.

If you set TaskType to DI_SOLUTION, set this parameter to the ID of the data synchronization solution that you want to deploy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType为DI_REALTIME时，则FileId为实时同步任务的文件ID。
当TaskType为DI_SOLUTION时，则FileId为同步解决方案的任务ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

schema.description_zh: 获取数据集成任务的返回结果

Data.description_zh: 获取数据集成任务的返回结果

AlarmList.description_en: The alert rules that are associated with the real-time synchronization task. The value of this parameter is an array
AlarmList.description_zh: 实时任务相关联的报警规则数组

items.description_en: The alert rule that is associated with the real-time synchronization task
items.description_zh: 单条实时任务相关联的报警规则

AlarmRuleList.description_en: The alert notification settings. The value of this parameter is an array

Aggregator.description_en:
The calculation method of a metric. Valid values:

avg

max
Aggregator.description_zh:
指标的计算方法：
avg 区间取平均
max 区间取最大值

Comparator.description_en:
The comparison operator, which indicates the method used to compare a metric with the alert rule.

'='

'<'

'>'
Comparator.description_zh:
比较符号，指标和告警规则的比较方法：
'=' 
'<'
'>'

Duration.description_en: The duration that a condition is met before an alert is triggered. Unit: minutes
Duration.description_zh: 持续时间，满足该条件持续多久才会触发报警，单位分钟

Level.description_zh:
WARNING  警告告警
CRITICAL 严重告警

Threshold.description_en: The threshold for the comparison between a metric and the alert rule
Threshold.description_zh: 指标和告警规则的比较阈值

Description.description_en: The description of the alert rule

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the alert rule is enabled

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

Metric.description_en:
The alert type. Valid values:

taskStatus

bizDelay

taskFailoverCount

ddlUnsupport

ddlReport

totalDirtyRecordWriteInLines
Metric.description_zh:
报警类型：

taskStatus 任务状态
bizDelay 业务延迟
taskFailoverCount 监控Failover
ddlUnsupport DDL不支持
ddlReport DDL通知
totalDirtyRecordWriteInLines 脏数据

NotifyRule.description_en: The settings for alert notification rules. The value of this parameter is an array

Critical.description_en: The settings for Critical-level alert notifications

items.description_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

Mail

Phone

Sms

Ding
items.description_zh:
通道，可选的枚举值：

Mail（邮件）
Phone（电话）
Sms（短信）
Ding（钉钉）

Warning.description_en: The settings for Warning-level alert notifications

items.description_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

Mail

Ding
items.description_zh:
通道，可选的枚举值：

Mail（邮件）
Phone（电话）

RuleName.description_en: The name of the alert rule

Code.description_en:
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_REALTIME, the details of the real-time synchronization task are returned.

If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_SOLUTION, the value null is returned
Code.description_zh:
如果TaskType为DI_REALTIME，则获取实时同步任务的详情。
如果TaskType为DI_SOLUTION，则为null

Message.description_en:
The cause of the failure to obtain the details of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution.

If the details of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution are obtained, the value null is returned
Message.description_zh:
获取数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。

如果获取数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

SolutionDetail.description_en:
If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_REALTIME, the value null is returned.

If the TaskType parameter is set to DI_SOLUTION, the details of the data synchronization solution are returned
SolutionDetail.description_zh:
如果TaskType为DI_REALTIME，则为null。
如果TaskType为DI_SOLUTION，则获取同步解决方案任务的详情

CreatorName.description_en: The creator of the data synchronization solution
CreatorName.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的创建者名称

Id.description_en: The ID of the data synchronization solution

Name.description_en: The name of the data synchronization solution
Name.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的名称

ProcessContent.description_en: The configuration details of the data synchronization solution
ProcessContent.description_zh: 同步解决方案的配置详情

ProcessExtra.description_en: The additional parameters of the data synchronization solution
ProcessExtra.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的额外参数

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the project to which the data synchronization solution belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务所在的项目ID

SourceType.description_en: The type of the source of the data synchronization solution
SourceType.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务源端的类型

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the data synchronization solution
StartTime.description_zh:
同步解决方案任务的开始时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2021-12-07 14:40:51`

Status.description_en:
The status of the data synchronization solution. Valid values:

0: successful

1: not running

2: running

3: failed

4: committed

5: pending manual confirmation

6: manually confirmed

7: others

8: waiting

9: deleted
Status.description_zh:
同步解决方案的执行状态

0-成功 
1-未运行 
2-运行中
3-失败 
4-提交
5-待人工确认
6-人工确认完成
7-其他 
8-等待 
9-已删除

SubmitTime.description_en: The time when the data synchronization solution was committed
SubmitTime.description_zh:
同步解决方案任务提交的时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2021-12-07 14:40:51`

Type.description_en: The type of the data synchronization solution
Type.description_zh: 同步解决方案任务的类型

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the details of the real-time synchronization task or data synchronization solution are obtained. Valid values:

success: The details are obtained. fail: The details fail to be obtained
Status.description_zh:
获取数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：

Success：表示获取数据集成同步任务成功。
Fail：表示获取数据集成同步任务失败

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
